<subject>MineSite Data Interface</subject>

ED:

A second MineSite Data Interface question:

MineSite Data Interface wants the definition of "Applicable Haulage Rate" to remain without changing to the Non-default Rate if the payee is the defaulting party. They say they must have a "balanced rate". Please let I hear from you. Katrina
